scope: Proposition 3.1 (Surface criterion) of the manuscript “The rational Hodge conjecture for CM abelian varieties” (preprints/The-rational-Hodge-conjecture-for-CM-abelian-varieties-October-6-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 032 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6e3e66a407773ad5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let E be a Galois CM field with conjugation c, and let v1, v2, v3, v4 : GE → {1, −1} be odd sign functions satisfying v1 + v2 = v3 + v4. Put λ = (1, 1, c, c). Suppose that S is a smooth connected projective complex surface and that there are rational Hodge maps hi : U(vi) −→ H1 (S, Q), 1 ≤ i ≤ 4, and nonzero vectors αi ∈ U(vi)λi ⊂ U(vi)Q such that Z S h1(α1) ⌣ h2(α2) ⌣ h3(α3) ⌣ h4(α4) ̸= 0. (3.1) Here each hi is extended to Q-coefficients. Then the line in Equation (2.4) is algebraic.
